BMRB:53960 is permanently excluded from all Phase 17 primary and backup candidate sets to preserve an uncompromisingly blind pre-registration firewall (p17_prereg_candidates.md §0.2).

rule_1_solver_and_shader_freeze.summary: Zero edits to solver/physics Rust modules or WebGPU WGSL shaders between pre-registration commit freeze and completion of single-shot empirical execution across all 8 gates, except F12(a) Kahan-summed weighted mean centering in varpro_two_param (relax_mc.wgsl) frozen in 17.W1 strictly before any F10-F17 network download.

allowed_pre_download_w1_exceptions.reason: Kahan-summed weighted mean centering in 2-parameter varpro_two_param frozen in 17.W1 strictly prior to downloading any F10-F17 dataset.

rule_2_a_priori_deterministic_format_con.summary: All format-adapter transformations from deposited archive syntax to CLI TSV inputs are purely syntactic or deterministic unit/header algebra fixed a priori before downloading a single byte.

fixed_conversions.trigger: Deposited NMR-STAR or plain-text table reports longitudinal/transverse relaxation times T1, T2, or T1rho in seconds (s) instead of rates in s^-1.

fixed_conversions.formula: median(T1_saveframe_A) > median(T1_saveframe_B) => A = 600.13 MHz, B = 360.13 MHz
fixed_conversions.trigger: BMRB 6470 NMR-STAR 2.1->3.1 remediation stamped both Tjandra et al. (1995) static fields with Spectrometer_frequency_1H = 600; folded ubiquitin T1 increases monotonically with B0 above omega_N * tau_m ~ 1, disambiguating 600.13 vs 360.13 MHz without inspecting S^2.

fixed_conversions.formula: I_norm = I / I0; sigma_norm = (I / I0) * sqrt((sigma_I / I)^2 + (sigma_I0 / I0)^2) when reference plane I0 row is separate; major_ppm_hint = argmin_offset(I_norm)
fixed_conversions.trigger: Plain-text saturation profile archives storing header B0/T_EX/B1_FRQ/B1_INH metadata and 3-column [offset, intensity, uncertainty] tables.

fixed_conversions.formula: 1D F2 exponential apodization (1.0 Hz), 2x zero-fill, FFT, phase locked on plane m = 0 (lowest gradient g_0), peak pick SNR >= 10 on plane m = 0 excluding residual HDO [4.65, 4.95] ppm, integrate fixed +-2*FWHM ppm boxes across m = 0..M-1
fixed_conversions.trigger: Raw Bruker ser+difflist or Varian fid+procpar pseudo-2D DOSY directories paired with nmrassign dosy --exp-dir.

fixed_conversions.formula: Join s_MTBLS1.txt (`Sample Name`, `Factor Value[Metabolic syndrome]`) 1-to-1 with a_MTBLS1_metabolite_profiling_NMR_spectroscopy.txt (`Raw Spectral Data File` .zip, ignoring duplicate .nmrML conversions)
fixed_conversions.trigger: MetaboLights MTBLS1 N = 132 human urinary cohort (84 Control Group, 48 diabetes mellitus).

rule_3_strict_fallback_order_without_tun.summary: If a primary archive URL is unreachable, corrupted/truncated, or missing required vendor headers upon first download, log the exact failure reason verbatim and step strictly in pre-registered order (primary -> co_primary -> backup_1 -> ...) using the identical frozen binary and CLI flags without parameter tuning.

rule_4_candid_single_shot_reporting.summary: Execute each gate single-shot after commit freeze and report all pre-registered evaluation metrics candidly in TODO.md, README.md, and CHANGELOG.md — including both quantitative agreements and any discrepancies, model mismatches, or archive/header failures.

evaluation_metrics_reported: `N = 132` (`84` `Control Group` vs `48` `diabetes mellitus`) ingestion completion rate, `PCA` variance explained & Hotelling `T^2` / `Q`-residual outlier count
Leak-free stratified 7-fold `OPLS-DA` cross-validated `Q^2`, `R^2_Y`, and 200-permutation `p`-value (`permutation_p_value_q2`, `is_validated`, plus `--permute-cohort-labels` null-label sanity check)

Top `VIP` / `S-plot` / `BH-FDR` Volcano and `STOCSY` urinary biomarker concordance against Salek et al. (2007) human T2DM markers (D-glucose `3.2-3.9 / 5.24 ppm`, citrate `2.54 / 2.68 ppm`, creatinine `3.05 / 4.05 ppm`, TMAO `3.27 ppm`, hippurate `7.55-7.84 ppm`, alanine `1.48 ppm`)
